tools.name: runn_get_me
tools.description: Return the Runn account that the API token belongs to. Use it first to check the connection. Runn API: GET /me/.

tools.name: runn_list_people
tools.description: List the people (resources) in the Runn account, with team, tags and skills. Filter by email, name or external id. Runn API: GET /people/.

tools.name: runn_get_person
tools.description: Return one person by id: name, email, team, tags, skills and custom fields. Runn API: GET /people/{personId}.

tools.name: runn_list_person_leave
tools.description: List the leave (time off) records of one person. Runn API: GET /people/{personId}/time-offs/leave.

tools.name: runn_list_projects
tools.description: List projects with pricing model, budget, client and manager ids. Archived projects are left out unless include_archived is true. Runn API: GET /projects/.

tools.name: runn_get_project
tools.description: Return one project by id: name, status flags, budget, client and manager ids, and tags. Runn API: GET /projects/{projectId}.

tools.name: runn_list_clients
tools.description: List the clients of the account. Runn API: GET /clients/.

tools.name: runn_list_phases
tools.description: List project phases (sub-periods of a project) with dates and budgets. Runn API: GET /phases/.

tools.name: runn_list_placeholders
tools.description: List placeholders (open roles that are not yet a named person). Runn API: GET /placeholders/.

tools.name: runn_list_assignments
tools.description: List planned assignments (who works on which project, in which role, how many minutes per day, between two dates). Runn API: GET /assignments/.

tools.name: runn_list_actuals
tools.description: List actuals: the hours people logged (timesheets), split into billable and nonbillable minutes, per person, project, role and day. Runn API: GET /actuals/.

tools.name: runn_create_assignment
tools.description: Plan work: assign one person to one project in one role, for a date range, with minutes per day (max 1440). Creates a new assignment each call; it does not check for overlaps first. Runn API: POST /assignments/.

tools.name: runn_log_time
tools.description: Log hours that one person worked on one project, in one role, on one day. Runn adds the minutes to the matching actual or creates one; each call adds more time. Runn API: POST /actuals/time-entry.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: runn_list_people, runn_get_person, runn_create_assignment · Private data: runn_get_me, runn_list_person_leave · Public sink: runn_list_people, runn_get_person, runn_create_assignment, runn_log_time.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: runn_list_people, runn_get_person, runn_create_assignment · Private data: runn_get_me, runn_list_person_leave · Public sink: runn_list_people, runn_get_person, runn_create_assignment, runn_log_time

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
